name: alert
description: A short message that needs attention: status, success, warning, or error. Not for long content.

use.when: something needs attention now: a failure, a warning before an action, or a result the person waited for.
use.not: content that stays on the page, a heading, or anything a person did not need to be interrupted for.
use.with: a status region for what changes over time; text for anything longer than two sentences.

title.description: Optional short title shown in bold before the message.

icon.description: Optional visual indicator shown before the title text.

dismiss.description: When true, renders a close button with data-dismiss attribute.

a11y.role: status for info and success, alert for warning and danger

keyboard.does: Focuses the close button when dismiss is enabled
Activates the close button, dismissing the alert

wcag.notes: Kind is conveyed by colour and optionally an icon prop (1.4.1). Warning and danger use role=alert so assistive tech announces them when inserted live.

machine.identify: Read data-kind for the severity and the text content for the message.
machine.operate: Interactive when dismiss is enabled: a close button (×) appears in the top-right corner. Tab to it, press Enter or Space to dismiss the alert.
